en.title: Sa Mu Trek near Tà Xùa: 2.756m Peak, Hut, Routes
en.excerpt: Sa Mu (U Bò) trek near Tà Xùa: 2.756m peak, 8km Xím Vàng trail, about 4 hours to a 40-guest hut, 2 days 1 night, guide needed. What Hang Chú is.
